visualCharacteristics.description: "Filter by" toggle expanding a panel with Brands and Type checkbox groups and Apply Filter / Clear All; below a 3-column grid of compact white tiles (linked blue title left, small thumbnail right, play overlay on videos). All items render at once.

contentPattern.description: Sheet mode: row 1 = one cell with a link to a sheet .json (columns title, link, image, video, brand, type, lastModified; brand/type comma-separated); optional row 2 = preselected filters ("Brand: X" / "Type: A, B"). The link is resolved against the page; on local dev (/content/...) /content is prefixed. Static mode: 1 row per item [thumbnail (video: linked to YouTube, add #_dnb) | linked title + tags paragraph "Brand, Type[, Type]"]. Filter: OR within a group, AND across groups.
contentPattern.structure: Sheet mode: 1 row, 1 cell = link to sheet .json (+ optional preselected-filter row). Static mode: 1 row per item: [thumbnail | linked title + "Brand, Type" tags]

suitableFor: filterable resource / knowledge libraries driven by a sheet
